newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Infratil to declare 2.25 NZ cps final div.
newsitem.headline: Infratil to declare 2.25 NZ cps final div.

text.p: Infrastructure and Utilities NZ Ltd (Infratil) said on Wednesday it intended to declare a final dividend of 2.25 NZ cents per share for the year ending March 31, subject to the finalisation of the financial results and audit.
"This final dividend together with the interim dividend paid on November 18, 1996, will represent a total distribution of three cents per share, all of which is fully imputed," Infratil said.
It said the declaration of the dividend would be announced following the finalisation of the financial result and audit for the year ended March 31.
